children.name: fields
children.description:
Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data.
if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields.
without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.

children.name: limit
children.description: Limit the number of items returned in the list.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include deleted records in the result.

types.name: listConfig
types.description: An object containing the select, relation, skip, take and order to be used with medusa internal services

children.name: select
children.description: An array of strings, each being attribute names of the entity to retrieve in the result.

children.name: skip
children.description: A number indicating the number of records to skip before retrieving the results.

children.name: take
children.description: A number indicating the number of records to return in the result.

children.name: relations
children.description:
An array of strings, each being relation names of the entity to retrieve in the result.

You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models
from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead.

children.name: order
children.description:
An object used to specify how to sort the returned records. Its keys are the names of attributes of the entity, and a key's value can either be `ASC`
to sort retrieved records in an ascending order, or `DESC` to sort retrieved records in a descending order.

children.name: withDeleted
children.description:
A boolean indicating whether deleted records should also be retrieved as part of the result. This only works if the entity extends the
`SoftDeletableEntity` class.

children.name: filters
children.description: Enable ORM specific defined filters

children.name: options
children.description: Enable ORM specific defined options

types.name: queryConfig
types.description: An object containing fields and variables to be used with the remoteQuery

types.name: filterableFields
types.description: An object containing the fields that are filterable e.g `{ id: Any<String> }`

types.name: allowed
types.description:
An array of fields and relations that are allowed to be queried, this can be set by the
consumer as part of a middleware and it will take precedence over the req.allowed set
by the api

Initialized per request, so add to it with `req.allowed.push(field)` — several
middlewares can each contribute that way. Reassigning the array discards what other
middlewares granted. To disallow an allowed field use [disallowed](/references/types/interfaces/types.MedusaRequest#disallowed), which is
applied after this list.

types.name: disallowed
types.description:
An array of fields and relations that must never be resolved, this can be set by the
consumer as part of a global middleware and it replaces the disallowed fields
configured by the route's query configuration

Since disallowed fields are a security boundary that keeps sensitive relations off an
endpoint, set this to the route's configured fields minus the ones you need, rather
than to a short list of your own. An empty array removes the boundary entirely.

types.name: restrictedFields
types.description:
The fields restricted from being selected in the response. Implemented by the


`RestrictedFields`

 class in 

`@medusajs/framework/http`

, which is what
populates 

MedusaRequest.restrictedFields

.

types.name: storeRelationsLimit
types.description:
The maximum number of relations that can be expanded by the request. It is only set for
routes under the `/store` prefix, and can be overridden by a route's query configuration.

types.name: pricingContext
types.description: An object that carries the context that is used to calculate prices for variants

types.name: context
types.description: A generic context object that can be used across the request lifecycle

types.name: additionalDataValidator
types.description:
Custom validator to validate the `additional_data` property in
requests that allows for additional\_data

types.name: locale
types.description:
The locale for the current request, resolved from:
1. Query parameter `?locale=`
2. x-medusa-locale header
3. Store's default locale

children.name: mfa_enabled
children.description: Whether the auth identity had an enabled MFA factor when the token was issued.

children.name: mfa_challenge_completed_at
children.description:
When the MFA challenge was completed, or null when it has not been. Routes
can require a recent completion to gate elevated actions.
